source.name: SportsPro: 'Seattle Sounders agree ten-year Providence main kit sponsor deal'
source.quote: Financial terms not disclosed, but reports suggest deal will reach figures close to US$10 million per year towards the end of the contract

note: Ten-year partnership announced 2023-01-20 (club's own release); price per SportsPro citing Sports Business Journal — the figure covers a multi-asset partnership (front of home and away shirts, team wear, medical partnership). In January 2026 the club announced the front-of-shirt portion ends at the conclusion of the 2027 'sprint' season, about six years early (Sounder at Heart, 2026-01-29, and the Seattle Times, which put the original deal at approximately $100 million in total, with a front-of-jersey opt-out after five years); Providence keeps the training-facility naming rights (Providence Swedish Performance Center & Clubhouse) through 2033 and healthcare/community work continues.
